Using `on:submit` to listen to the submit event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onsubmit` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:change` to listen to the change event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onchange` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

`selected` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update

`answer` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
